name: Kinetic Roman Numeral Chapter Navigation
description: Choreograph roman numeral scene markers (e.g., I, II, III, IV) with letter-by-letter kinetic stagger reveals. As each project scrolls into the viewport, animate line-height and opacity using cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) easing.
designPhilosophy: Choreograph roman numeral scene markers (e.g., I, II, III, IV) with letter-by-letter kinetic stagger reveals
implementationApproach: Include automatic prefers-reduced-motion fallback that delivers instant static typography for users requiring vestibular accessibility.
performanceConsiderations: Utilize translate3d, will-change sparingly, and clamp animation timelines under 600ms.
accessibilityRequirements: Provide prefers-reduced-motion override and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard focus visibility.
